item.title: Absence of Sanction Letter as per RBI Guideline Does Not Invalidate Financial Debt, NCLAT Sets Aside NCLT Order Against NBFC [Read Order]
item.description: The NCLT had dismissed the NBFC’s Section 7 application on the ground that no sanction letter or loan agreement was produced as required under RBI guidelines.

item.title: Steel Manufacturer's Appeal Allowed: CESTAT Quashes Excise Duty Demand for Lack of Evidence on Clandestine Clearance [Read Order]
item.description: The Tribunal ruled that Section 11D cannot be invoked for double recovery where duty was already paid, and penalties were quashed in the absence of proof of personal involvement.

item.title: Limitation for ITAT Rectification Begins from Date of Communication of Order to Taxpayer, Not Date of Passing: Bombay HC [Read Order]
item.description: The Bombay High Court held that the limitation period for filing an ITAT rectification application starts from the date the order is communicated to the taxpayer, not from the date it is passed.

item.title: Non-Communication of Extension u/s 28(9) Customs Act Does Not Invalidate Adjudication Process: Delhi HC [Read Order]
item.description: The Delhi High Court ruled that failure to communicate an extension granted under Section 28(9) of the Customs Act does not invalidate the adjudication proceedings.

item.title: Retracted Statements, No Corroboration: CESTAT Quashes ₹49.62L Excise Demand in Gutkha Manufacturing Case [Read Order]
item.description: The Tribunal noted that the mandatory procedure prescribed under Section 9D of the Central Excise Act, 1944 was not followed.

item.title: SEBI Notifies New Regulations for Registrars to an Issue and Share Transfer Agents [Read Notification]
item.description: SEBI has notified new regulations to strengthen oversight, governance, and investor protection for registrars to an issue and share transfer agents.

item.title: GST Portal Faces Intermittent Technical Glitches, Document Upload Issues Fixed After CA Alerts Infosys
item.description: The issue affected multiple GST modules before GST Support confirmed that the glitch had been resolved.

item.title: MCA Issues Clarification on SPICe+ Resubmission Process for Company Incorporation
item.description: MCA clarifies how SPICe Plus resubmissions will be handled to ensure smoother company incorporation.

item.title: Accountant fails to Submit GST Returns for 6 Months: Madras HC orders GSTN to take Necessary Actions for filing Returns [Read Order]
item.description: The Court directed the tax authorities to instruct GSTN, New Delhi, to make suitable changes in the GST portal architecture so as to enable the petitioner to file pending returns and make payment of dues within a stipulated period of four weeks

item.title: Mere Non-Filling of Part-B of E-Way Bill due to Technical Glitch cannot attract GST Penalty without Intent to Evade Tax: Allahabad HC [Read Order]
item.description: The Allahabad High Court has held that mere non-filling of Part B of an e-way bill due to a technical glitch cannot attract GST penalty without proof of intent to evade tax.
